title: Neural Networks
objectives:
To familiarize students with the concepts of neural networks, their learning
algorithms, and their applications in classification and regression tasks, as well as
specific and general neural networks.
To provide the necessary skills to use and implement neural networks in major
applications.
Students will become familiar with the basic concepts of neural networks.
The various classes of neural networks with an emphasis on their application in
classification and regression tasks will be introduced.
Concepts such as multi-layer perceptron (MLP), convolutional neural networks
(CNNs), and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) will be introduced.
Students will be familiarized with the basics of training algorithms and regularization
methods.
The advantages and disadvantages of different neural network models will be
discussed, and students will be introduced to various training algorithms.
Students will learn to implement neural networks in real-world scenarios, focusing on
their applications in classification, regression, and pattern generation.
syllabus:
Introduction to neural networks
Single-layer perceptrons
Multi-layer perceptrons
Training algorithms for MLPs
Convolutional neural networks (CNNs)
Recurrent neural networks (RNNs)
Applications in classification and regression tasks
Special neural network architectures
Neural network applications in pattern generation
